meta.parties: De Silva Et Al v. Sangananda Unanse Et Al

rules.statement: The court held that the jus retentionis is a legal implication of the declaration in the decree that the improver was entitled to compensation, and not explicitly reserving it.
rules.supporting_quote: "Moreover in this case the improver was authorized by the soil owner to continue in possession, and he or rather his representatives, were in possession of the buildings at the time the question of compensation arose in these proceedings inasmuch as the school was being conducted in them. They were persons interested in the allotment of the compensation tendered"
